text:
Tom: Quick pet drop — Baxter discovered my travel blanket and declared it a cape. pic: https://files.slack.com/files-pri/T12345-F12345/baxter_cape.jpg
Maya: OMG :cape_with_hood: he looks like a tiny superhero
Leo: that tail = dramatic flourish :heart_eyes:
Asha: Is he trained to fetch the mail now or only snacks?
Tom: Only snacks. He attempted a heroic leap and settled mid-air nuzzle. GIF: https://giphy.com/gifs/dog-leap
Elliot: caption contest: "Baxter saves the couch from boredom." Winner gets a sticker :trophy:
Maya: "Every blanket is a destiny." — 1k upvotes
Frankie: did someone say sticker? count me in 😂
dev-bot: Reminder: Team photo contest entries due Friday — drop them in #random! :camera:
Tom: also full disclosure: cape acquired via snack bribery. He now demands theme music.
Leo: can confirm, theme is "Eye of the Tiger" on repeat in my head
Asha: vote: should Baxter get a cape of his own (versus stealing blankets)? react with :thumbsup: for yes, :thumbsdown: for no
Maya: :thumbsup:
Elliot: :thumbsup:
Frankie: :thumbsup:
Leo: :thumbsup:
Tom: tally so far 4 yes, 0 no. He's a cape boy. Thanks all — bedtime for hero.
